Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''''Acclamator''-class assault ship''' was used to transport [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino's]] [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], just prior to the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]].<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The episode "[[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Troopers]]" has Skywalker and Kenobi take the ''Acclamator''-class assault ship to Tipoca City, while the book ''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic]]'' states that they took a Republic shuttle to the city.
